description:
Planning only; exclusive test path: test/zaq/engine/conversations_missed_branches_test.exs (new). Do not edit existing tests, implementation, migrations, or other test paths in this issue. Source: lib/zaq/engine/conversations.ex; missed 363,377,388,503,521,548,600,626,636,637,639,647,649,654,659,674,750,766,806,850,1070,1084,1129,1159-1162,1261,1280,1504,1750,1783,1879. Parent owns mix q and targeted --cover; never run full suite or coveralls as this issue's coverage verification. No application/test execution by planner.

Functional specification / tests before implementation: New Zaq.Engine.ConversationsMissedBranchesTest uses Zaq.DataCase; exercise real Conversations public APIs, assert exact returned errors, persisted row counts/UUIDs/metadata and unchanged state after rollback. Group independent examples by admission, finalization, history, rating, telemetry. Avoid BO direct access and fake internal modules. Tests do not change operations, contracts, or docs; Action reuse not applicable (test-only coverage of established Conversations operations). New-feature E2E not applicable (no UX/UI feature or journey). Engine policy/docs/testing-approach.md and docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md govern implementation.

Admissions: (363) construct Incoming.new with routing_context.source_scope = :invalid, assert {:error,:invalid_history_source} and no messages. (377) valid nonblank message_id, routing_context kind :room + missing/invalid connector configuration -> canonical_admission_source :none; assert legacy admission succeeds and replay reuses UUID. (388,503,659,674) absent and separately empty message_id (empty requires explicit %Incoming{... | message_id: ""}, since Incoming.new normalizes empty); assert two admissions yield distinct rows, no external_message_id in metadata, no dedup. Ensure one case has supported kind (to hit 503) and one no kind (388); incoming metadata stays private. (521) nil locked canonical row after successful lookup is a genuine concurrent deletion race, cannot be forced by ordinary fixtures; classify as blocker pending safe event-driven lock choreography and Sandbox ownership, not a fabricated mock. (548) unreachable with supported CommunicationPolicy.kind: its three kinds map exhaustively in Facts.strategy; document coverage exception unless product changes mapping. (600) adoption Repo.update error: arrange valid captured external canonical row with source/account and matching placement, then induce a real changeset/DB update failure without test-only hooks; otherwise document blocked by current Message.changeset allowing valid adoption and no stable public invalid input. Verify captured row remains external and no admission token minted on error.

Admission uniqueness/races: (626) a normal invalid admitted Message.changeset (e.g. whitespace content with no attachments) should return changeset and create no message; ensure it reaches insert rather than an earlier guard. (636-639,647,649,654) recover_admitted_message_conflict is reached only after a metadata unique-index violation between lookup and INSERT; do not call private functions. If deterministic two-process test can be made: use distinct Sandbox-allowed processes, hold a real DB transaction/lock, signal using messages/monitors when reads/writes cross race barrier (never sleep/poll), let competing admissions insert same conversation/external ID; assert same-content returns original UUID/token nil, changed content returns :source_conflict and non-metadata changeset propagates; if PostgreSQL unique violation aborts enclosing transaction or lock_source_identity serializes the race, record 636-639/647/649/654 as unreachable without a production-meaningful seam. In particular 647->nil (654) requires deletion between conflict and relookup and may be impossible under row locking. Preserve DB integrity; never mutate global mocks or production code solely for line coverage.

Finalization: (750) nil/non-map result or nonbinary ID/token -> :invalid_finalization with admitted row unchanged. (766) generated UUID absent in DB -> :user_message_not_found. (806) create ordinary persisted role=user message with missing/nonpending execution_status, compute matching token hash in fixture only if necessary via public admission then Repo.update metadata to change status, assert :message_not_admitted, no assistant. (850) admit + failed result (error:true) + artifact whose normalized record is invalid map shape (existing conversations_test.exs:556 precedent), assert artifact changeset, transaction rollback preserves pending input, no artifact/assistant. No sleeps or outbound calls.

History/identity: (1070) nil provider Incoming leads channel_type api and persisted group; (1084) explicit metadata.conversation_id is unknown UUID -> :conversation_not_found, no new conversation/message. (1129,1159-1162) scoped identity from CommunicationBridge.put_conversation_identity/1; concurrent create of same scope after both see nil can trigger channel_user_id unique changeset; assert recover returns existing conversation (1161), or returns changeset (1162) if losing row disappears before requery. A validated invalid unique conflict elsewhere returns unchanged changeset (1165); do not assume deterministic reachability: existing scope index plus Sandbox and transaction serialization may prevent constructing the branch. Event-driven DB barrier or explicit coverage exception, never scheduler sleeps or private-function exposure. (1261) Incoming with one Record attachment and persist_message_history/2 with metadata custom key -> stored metadata contains normalized attachment descriptor and custom key, no bytes; reuse existing Record example in conversations_test.exs:1017. (1280) whitespace-only subject on new history conversation -> persisted title nil (already tested in conversations_test.exs:1504; check targeted report before duplicating).

Reads/ratings/telemetry: (1504) add rating for Person A on a message; list_messages(conv,rating_person_id: nil or 0 or string) -> ratings [] while stored rating remains; contrast positive A returns exact rating and no Person B leak. (1750) rate_message_by_source malformed reference / missing rating -> :invalid_request, no writes. (1783) existing canonical captured source, active connector and resolved Person; force upsert_rating changeset error through a real legal API input (for example duplicate-person/actor validation if public attrs can reach it) and assert {:error, changeset}, no rating; if rating 1..5 and sanitized attrs make errors impossible except nondeterministic concurrent uniqueness/DB failure, record as blocked rather than mock internal upsert. Reuse scoped_channel_rating_test.exs:204-320 fixture pattern, but do not edit it. (1879) add valid role=user message to a conversation; assert returned row and no qa.answer.count emitted via existing telemetry Buffer/Point patterns in conversations_test.exs:1624 (note this line may already be exercised by existing tests, verify targeted coverage freshness).

Helpers, isolation, property assessment: reuse Incoming.new, CommunicationBridge.put_conversation_identity, ChannelConfig.changeset+Repo.insert!, Conversations.create_conversation/add_message/admit_incoming/finalize_incoming/persist_message_history/capture_canonical_message, People.create_person/add_channel and Zaq.DataCase sandbox. Keep per-example generated unique provider IDs, no external networks, no blanket NodeRouterMock, and no new Mox definitions; direct context integration is the smallest trustworthy level. Ordinary DB-only tests async:true in new module if no shared services; telemetry Buffer is globally named, put telemetry-only scenarios in a separate async:false module in SAME exclusive file, with safe cleanup/state restore. If concurrency DB tests are feasible, use monitored tasks/explicit Sandbox.allow for child PIDs and assert_receive messages as barriers; isolate async:false only if shared Sandbox mode or global state required. Property assessment: existing scoped_channel_rating_test.exs:323 already proves connector+room isolation via ExUnitProperties; optional bounded new property for absent/empty message IDs always mint distinct user UUIDs, if meaningful across varied valid providers; no property for one-off failure responses. Security: nil/unknown Person is never implicit read/rating permission; assert invalid Person selector returns empty ratings, actor resolution returns :unresolved_actor; no authorization bypass. No assertions on internal calls or timing.

Validation / handoff: implementation owner runs focused mix test test/zaq/engine/conversations_missed_branches_test.exs then targeted --cover scoped to this module/path and reviews missed-line changes, plus mix q per workflow, and reserves mix precommit for final approval gate; parent explicitly owns mix q and targeted --cover for this delegation. No full suite, no coveralls. If an identified race/error path cannot be reproduced with public contracts and real DB transactions, record exact lines and why in issue/coverage exception rather than test-only hooks, global mutation, weakened assertions, or artificial database corruption. Existing relevant tests: test/zaq/engine/conversations_test.exs, test/zaq/engine/conversations/canonical_history_capture_test.exs, test/zaq/engine/scoped_channel_rating_test.exs; these are read-only for this issue.

comments.text: Implemented test/zaq/engine/conversations_missed_branches_test.exs: 15 focused integration tests pass, including invalid admission source/content, legacy replay and empty IDs, finalization guards/rollback, unknown conversation, nil-provider grouping, attachment metadata, whitespace title, invalid rating selectors/source reference, and user telemetry. Targeted command: mix test test/zaq/engine/conversations_missed_branches_test.exs (run under the prescribed fcntl lock); 15 tests, 0 failures. Reachability exceptions documented from source: lines 377 and 503 cannot be entered through public admit_incoming because its binary-ID routing branch calls canonical_admission_source whose fallback :none clause at 503 is guarded to non-binary IDs, while non-binary IDs dispatch earlier at 388 (or routing_context conversation_type nil at 366); supported-ID invalid connector/source yields {:error, :invalid_history_source}, not :none. Lines 521 require canonical row deletion after lookup and before FOR UPDATE; 548 is the unreachable fallback for Facts.strategy after CommunicationPolicy/Facts supported kinds are already normalized exhaustively. Lines 600 require Repo.update failure for an otherwise valid canonical external message; normal Message.changeset-valid adoption exposes no stable legal invalid input. Lines 636-654 and 1129/1159-1165 require actual concurrent uniqueness races and competing state changes; no event barrier is exposed by the public APIs, and no private hooks, sleeps, or fabricated DB corruption were used. Lines 1783 upsert changeset error is likewise not reproducible with sanitized rating 1..5 attrs (requires nondeterministic DB failure/race). These are evidence-based reachability exceptions; remaining reproducible planned behaviors are covered.
